# DARASK integration changes

Based on dsh-grok-provider 1.0.5 (MIT, YukiRyou). Original licenses and browser bundle retained.

- Preserve encrypted-only reasoning through native DSH BlockAssembler and request replay.
- Convert verified native WebP request projections to PNG within route byte limits, preserving alpha and durable attachment references.
- Japanese interruption notice; preserve the upstream no-replay policy.
- Host loads from maintained source; npm installs this local bundled fork. No edits to installed packages or generated bundles.

Image wire formats: https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/images/understanding
